No Va Land Investment Group Corporation (‘the Company") respectfully submits the disclosure letter relating to
the Financial Statements according to Clause 3 and Clause 4, Article 14, Chapter III, including:

1. The Separate Financial Statements — Quarter 4/2024;

2. The Consolidated Financial Statements — Quarter 4/2024;

3. The disclosure letter explaining the variance from 10% and above of consolidated profit after tax compared
to the same period last year;

4. The disclosure letter explaining the variance from 10% and above of separate profit after tax compared to
the same period last year and the transition from the loss in the same period last year to the profit in current
period.
